title: Knowledge check: Vue Development Tools

questions.prompt: Which approach best matches “Vue Development Tools”?
options: Vue uses declarative templates and reactive state to keep an interface in sync with application data.
Vue requires manual DOM mutation for every state change.
Vue is a database engine for storing server records.
Vue replaces HTML and CSS with a single language.
questions.answer_key: Vue uses declarative templates and reactive state to keep an interface in sync with application data.
questions.explanation: This answer addresses Vue Development Tools directly. Verify the behavior in a small Vue 3 example and check the runtime requirements in the linked official reference.

questions.prompt: For “Code editors”, which practice is most reliable?
options: Vue requires manual DOM mutation for every state change.
Vue is a database engine for storing server records.
Vue replaces HTML and CSS with a single language.
Vue uses declarative templates and reactive state to keep an interface in sync with application data.
questions.answer_key: Vue uses declarative templates and reactive state to keep an interface in sync with application data.
questions.explanation: This practice supports the syllabus subtopic “Code editors”. Check the expected result and a relevant boundary or failure case.

questions.prompt: A learner example for “Vue Development Tools” behaves unexpectedly. What should be checked first?
options: Disable error handling and assume the framework is at fault.
Trust a client-supplied success flag without checking behavior.
Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
Change unrelated files until the page looks correct.
questions.answer_key: Reproduce the state or input change, inspect the relevant Vue binding or dependency, and compare the result with the expected output.
questions.explanation: Start with a small reproducible case. Inspect the element, reactive source, Console, and expected result before changing unrelated code.

review_note: Answer keys and explanations are server-side data. Human review required before publication.
